name: Nimbus Docs Squad Orchestrator
description: Answers developer questions about the Nimbus SDK (v2/v3). Delegates to a version/deprecation worker and a code-sample worker and returns one cited answer. Design-only card: this repo does not serve it over A2A yet.

provider.organization: Soft Suave AI Engineering League (training project)

bearer.description: Per-developer API token; the orchestrator calls its workers with its own service credentials.

skills.name: Version and deprecation lookup
skills.description: Version-specific facts, defaults, error-code retryability and v2-to-v3 changes, cited to the docs.
examples: For SDK v2, what pool_size does Client.connect() use by default?

skills.name: Code sample for a target SDK version
skills.description: Short parseable Python usage snippet for the resolved SDK version. Needs a target version; asks for one (input-required) when the question does not state it and the version check is unavailable.
examples: Explain how Client.send() handles a RATE_LIMITED response from the gateway.
